title: Peacock eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Peacock body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='62' rx='14' ry='16' fill='#1a6bcc'/>
  <!-- Chest lighter -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='66' rx='9' ry='11' fill='#2e8fe0'/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <path d='M45 48 Q43 38 46 30' stroke='#1a6bcc' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='28' r='7' fill='#2e8fe0'/>
  <!-- Crest -->
  <line x1='47' y1='21' x2='44' y2='14' stroke='#22c55e' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='47' y1='21' x2='48' y2='13' stroke='#22c55e' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='47' y1='21' x2='52' y2='14' stroke='#22c55e' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='14' r='2' fill='#facc15'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='13' r='2' fill='#facc15'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='14' r='2' fill='#facc15'/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='27' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='50.5' cy='27' r='0.9' fill='#0a0a3a'/>
  <!-- Beak -->
  <polygon points='53,29 60,31 53,33' fill='#f59e0b'/>
  <!-- Snack (seed/bread) in beak -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='31' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#d4a017'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='31' rx='2.5' ry='1.8' fill='#f0c850'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <line x1='41' y1='76' x2='39' y2='88' stroke='#f59e0b' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <line x1='49' y1='76' x2='51' y2='88' stroke='#f59e0b' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <path d='M36 88 L42 88' stroke='#f59e0b' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M48 88 L54 88' stroke='#f59e0b' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Tail feathers fanned out -->
  <g>
    <path d='M33 60 Q15 45 10 25' stroke='#22c55e' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M31 56 Q12 38 8 18' stroke='#16a34a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M34 66 Q14 58 6 42' stroke='#22c55e' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M33 70 Q16 70 6 62' stroke='#16a34a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- Eye spots on feathers -->
    <circle cx='11' cy='26' r='3.2' fill='#facc15'/>
    <circle cx='11' cy='26' r='1.8' fill='#1e3a8a'/>
    <circle cx='9' cy='19' r='2.8' fill='#facc15'/>
    <circle cx='9' cy='19' r='1.6' fill='#1e3a8a'/>
    <circle cx='7' cy='42' r='2.8' fill='#facc15'/>
    <circle cx='7' cy='42' r='1.6' fill='#1e3a8a'/>
    <circle cx='7' cy='62' r='2.8' fill='#facc15'/>
    <circle cx='7' cy='62' r='1.6' fill='#1e3a8a'/>
  </g>
</svg>
